resources.string: Review the name and details before adding an action. Medication also needs a checked dose, unit, route, frequency and start/end dates. Missing or unclear information must be clarified with your clinician.

This is your transcription of a clinical instruction, not clinician verification or a new recommendation. A reminder applies only to the time you select; it does not calculate a treatment schedule. Changing or removing this instruction invalidates its previous reminders.
I checked these details against the original and clarified any uncertain dates or instructions. Adding this action does not change the clinical instruction.
